endpoints.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a UK postcode.
endpoints.description: Returns 404 if the postcode is not found; a terminated postcode's 404 response includes a terminated property.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: UK postcode to look up; case and spacing do not matter.

endpoints.summary: Retrieve data for up to 100 postcodes in one request.
endpoints.description: Send a JSON body with a postcodes array and Content-Type application/json. Postcodes not found return a null result. Also: Find the nearest postcodes for up to 100 coordinate pairs in one request. Each geolocation object takes longitude and latitude, and may override limit, radius, widesearch and filter.

parameters.name: postcodes
parameters.description: Array of up to 100 UK postcodes to look up.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Comma-separated whitelist of attributes to include in each result object.

parameters.name: geolocations
parameters.description: Array of geolocation objects, maximum 100.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of postcodes to return for each location, below 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, below 2000.

parameters.name: widesearch
parameters.description: Extends the search radius up to 20km, returning at most 10 results.

endpoints.summary: Search for postcodes matching a query string.
endpoints.description: Also: Find the nearest postcodes to a longitude and latitude pair. Each result includes a distance field in metres from the given coordinates.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query string.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Alias for q.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, max 100.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, between -180 and 180.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, between -90 and 90.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000.

parameters.name: widesearch
parameters.description: Extends the search to a 20km radius, returning at most 10 results; ignores radius and limit when true.

endpoints.summary: Find postcodes nearest to a given postcode, ordered by distance.
endpoints.description: Each result includes a distance field in metres. Returns 404 if the input postcode is not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The postcode to search from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of postcodes to return, max 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000.

endpoints.summary: Return a list of postcodes matching a partial postcode.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The partial postcode to match.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matches to return, below 100.

endpoints.summary: Returns a random postcode with all its available data.
endpoints.description: Optionally filter by outcode; an invalid outcode returns null.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: Filters random postcodes by outcode, e.g. CM8 or SW1.

endpoints.summary: Returns detailed information about a UK outward code.
endpoints.description: Matching is case-insensitive. Returns 404 if the outward code is not found.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: The outward code, e.g. BR8.

endpoints.summary: Returns the nearest outcodes to a longitude and latitude, ordered by proximity.
endpoints.description: Each result has the same shape as an outcode lookup.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, a WGS84 value between -180 and 180.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, a WGS84 value between -90 and 90.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of outcode matches to return; maximum 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres; maximum 25000.

endpoints.summary: Returns the outcodes nearest to the given outcode, ordered by proximity.
endpoints.description: Returns 404 if the input outcode is not found.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: The outward code to search from, e.g. NW1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of outcodes to return; maximum 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres; maximum 25000.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a GB place by its OSGB code.
endpoints.description: Returns 404 if the place is not found.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: OSGB code of the place, e.g. osgb4000000074564391.

endpoints.summary: Searches for places whose names match a query string.
endpoints.description: Full-text matches primary and secondary names case-insensitively, falling back to prefix matching when there is no full-text hit. Returns an empty array or up to 100 places.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query string.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Alias for q.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, max 100.

endpoints.summary: Returns a random place with all available data for that place.
Retrieves information about a UK postcode that is no longer in use.
endpoints.description: Matches inputs regardless of case or spacing, e.g. E1W 1UU or e1w1uu. Returns 404 if the terminated postcode is not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The terminated postcode, with or without spaces.

endpoints.summary: Returns the full Scottish Postcode Directory record for a Scottish postcode.
endpoints.description: Matches inputs regardless of case or spacing, e.g. AB10 1XG or ab101xg. Returns 404 if the postcode is not in the SPD, with a specific message if it exists in ONSPD only.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The Scottish postcode, with or without spaces.
